title: Europe & Mediterranean selection regions
note: Modern administrative extents and documented approximate composites for selection and animation over a historical background. These are not AD 1300 political borders or dated disease-spread boundaries.

sources.name: BKG government districts 2021 via geoBoundaries DEU ADM2
sources.attribution: © GeoBasis-DE / BKG 2021, via geoBoundaries; dissolved and simplified by FrameFlow.

changes: Selected source components, dissolved shared edges, simplified at 0.001 degrees, quantized to 0.00001 degrees; named composites and island filters documented per feature.

properties.name: Algeria / Coastal Algeria
properties.label: Coastal Algeria
properties.note: Approximate coastal belt: all 14 source wilayas with a Mediterranean coast, including their inland portions.

properties.name: Baltic states / Livonia
properties.label: Livonia
properties.note: Broad Latvia-and-Estonia proxy requested for the map; not a reconstructed medieval Livonian border. Latvia and Estonia are also available separately.

properties.name: Belgium / Flanders
properties.label: Flanders
properties.note: Modern Flemish Region: five provinces; not the medieval County of Flanders.

properties.name: Croatia / Dalmatia
properties.label: Dalmatia
properties.note: Approximate extent: Zadar, Šibenik-Knin, Split-Dalmatia and Dubrovnik-Neretva counties.

properties.name: Denmark / Jutland
properties.label: Jutland
properties.note: Jutland mainland and northern/nearby islands from the three western Danish regions; Funen and southern islands excluded.

properties.name: Denmark / Zealand
properties.label: Zealand
properties.note: Approximate extent using Zealand and Capital regions; Bornholm excluded, nearby southern islands retained.

properties.name: France / Burgundy
properties.label: Burgundy
properties.note: Former Burgundy administrative region: Côte-d’Or, Nièvre, Saône-et-Loire and Yonne; excludes Franche-Comté.

properties.name: Germany / Franconia
properties.label: Franconia
properties.note: Approximate cultural extent using the three Bavarian administrative districts Upper, Middle and Lower Franconia; other Franconian areas are excluded.

properties.name: Germany / Rhineland
properties.label: Rhineland
properties.note: Approximate extent combining Düsseldorf, Cologne, Koblenz, Trier, Rheinhessen-Pfalz and Saarland government districts.

properties.name: Ireland / Dublin
properties.label: Dublin
properties.note: Dublin, Fingal, South Dublin and Dún Laoghaire–Rathdown combined.

properties.name: Ireland / East coast
properties.label: East coast
properties.note: Approximate eastern coastal belt: Louth, Meath, Dublin, Wicklow and Wexford, including inland county areas.

properties.name: Netherlands / Holland
properties.label: Holland
properties.note: North Holland and South Holland provinces combined.

properties.name: Norway / Bergen
properties.label: Bergen
properties.note: Approximate Bergen-area extent using the source’s Hordaland county boundary, not Bergen municipality.

properties.name: Poland / Pomerania
properties.label: Pomerania
properties.note: Polish West Pomeranian and Pomeranian voivodeships combined; German Vorpommern excluded.

properties.name: Poland / Prussia
properties.label: Prussia
properties.note: Approximate East Prussia proxy: modern Warmian-Masurian voivodeship and Kaliningrad oblast. Extends across modern Poland and Russia.

properties.name: Russia / Moscow
properties.label: Moscow
properties.note: Modern oblast extent plus Moscow city.

properties.name: Russia / Novgorod
properties.label: Novgorod
properties.note: Modern oblast extent; not the medieval principality boundary.

properties.name: Russia / Pskov
properties.label: Pskov
properties.note: Modern oblast extent; not the medieval principality boundary.

properties.name: Sweden / Southern Sweden
properties.label: Southern Sweden
properties.note: Approximate southern extent: Västra Götaland, Östergötland, Kalmar, Blekinge, Skåne, Halland, Gotland, Jönköping and Kronoberg.

properties.name: Switzerland / Whole country
properties.label: Whole country
properties.note: Modern Switzerland outline, assembled from its cantons.

properties.name: Tunisia / Tunis
properties.label: Tunis
properties.note: Tunis governorate, rather than the entire metropolitan area.

properties.name: Turkey / Istanbul
properties.label: Istanbul
properties.note: Istanbul province, rather than only the historic city.

properties.name: Ukraine / Crimea
properties.label: Crimea
properties.note: Crimean peninsula: Crimea and Sevastopol administrative extents.

properties.name: United Kingdom / Rest of England
properties.label: Rest of England
properties.note: England excluding South West England, London and South East England.

components.name: Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead

properties.name: United Kingdom / Yorkshire and the Humber
properties.label: Yorkshire and the Humber
